content:
simon: heads up — Snyk flagged two serious go deps: CVE-2026-0421 in google.golang.org/grpc and CVE-2026-0422 in golang.org/x/oauth2. also a medium info-leak report for net/http (CVE-2025-6789) from our vendor scanner.

maria: thanks. which services import these directly?

simon: quick grep:
- grpc: inference-runtime, batch-serv, routing-proxy
- oauth2: console-auth, private-controlplane
- net/http: a bunch of internal tools and some admin dashboards

kevin: any known exploit PoC?

simon: none public for grpc yet, oauth2 CVE has a PoC that shows token leakage on specific refresh flows when using older oauth2 client code. net/http is low exploitability but can leak headers under specific redirect combos.

jamie: severity wise we should treat grpc and oauth2 as P1 for runtime services. net/http P2.

olga: agree. grpc exposure is our main concern — routing-proxy touches external traffic and batch-serv sees customer payloads. recommend immediate pin + test + canary for routing-proxy.

infra-bot: automated triage record created: TRIAGE-2026-1783 by simon — affected services inventory attached.

maria: proposed patches (dev branch):
```
// go get lines for the fix
go get google.golang.org/grpc@v1.59.0
go get golang.org/x/oauth2@v0.0.0-20260210-abcdef1234
```
and add a replace directive if downstream libs pull older oauth2 transiently.

kevin: fine, but we should prefer the smallest compatible grpc bump that includes the fix to avoid ABI surprises. is v1.59.0 the minimally patched?

simon: Snyk points to fix landed in v1.59.0. I'll validate with upstream changelog and run `go mod graph` to see transitive pulls.

jamie: test plan: unit + integration + fuzzing on grpc handlers focusing on stream-handling and header parsing. oauth2: auth flow unit tests including refresh token path. net/http: add redirect header tests.

olga: rollout plan:
- create `hotfix/grpc-oauth-2026-0421-0422` branch
- run CI (unit/integration/e2e-routes)
- merge to staging, deploy canary to 5% of traffic on routing-proxy and 2 nodes of batch-serv for 6 hours
- if no errors, promote to 50%, run 24h, then full rollout
- include automatic rollback on error rate > 0.5% or p50 latency +20%

maria: tagging and changelog: add `security: CVE-2026-0421, CVE-2026-0422, CVE-2025-6789` in PR body and link TRIAGE-2026-1783.

kevin: what about private-controlplane (on-prem)? we can't force upgrades. need advisory + pinned minimal versions. security notice draft?

simon: I'll prepare an advisory with affected versions list, mitigation (apply patch or block refresh flow), and recommended timeline (7 days for supported Dedicated, 30 days for on-prem advisory).

olga: KMS integration? any impact on key handling or audit logs?

simon: KMS/HSM not affected by these deps. audit logs unaffected, but we should ensure we capture the deploy rollout metadata and include a sec-tag in audit events for the rollout.

jamie: CI checklist for the PR:
- run `go test ./...` with race detector
- run integration tests against local grpc server with proto fuzz inputs
- staticcheck and govulncheck before merge
- smoke deploy to staging with tracing enabled

maria: assign owners: simon -> patch + go.mod, kevin -> CI/fuzz, jamie -> rollout plan + canary checks, olga -> advisory + comms.

simon: I'll open the PR now, naming `hotfix/triage/CVE-2026-0421-0422`. will include minimal `go get` changes and a short migration note.

infra-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood.example/hotfix/triage/CVE-2026-0421-0422 (CI started).

kevin: nice. who will own post-deploy verification? I'll watch SLO dashboards for latency and error spikes during canary window. jamie pls check tracing and request ids.

jamie: will do. also schedule a short postmortem call if any regressions show up.

maria: thanks team. simon — once PR merges, add the deploy metadata to security audit logs and update the incident tracker with links.

simon: will do. final note — for net/http low-priority CVE, I'll open a follow-up PR that pins to go1.21.9+ patched runtime or adds specific header handling tests. not blocking the grpc/oauth2 hotfix.

olga: good. closing the triage thread once PR merged and advisory published. :white_check_mark:
